title.zh: 让频谱仪接收自己的输出
title.en: Let the analyser receive complex data

t.zh: 二维处理要把第一条轴的结果送往第二条轴，它已不再只有实数读数。先扩展现有频谱仪的输入契约，避免第二次处理时丢掉一半信息。 <wiki-ref to="complex-transform"></wiki-ref>
t.en: A second image axis receives complex results from the first. Extend the analyser’s input contract before that pass so it does not drop half the information. <wiki-ref to="complex-transform"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 复用实数频谱仪处理两分量，再按复数关系组合；第二条轴不能静默丢弃虚部。 <wiki-ref to="complex-transform"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Reuse the real-valued analyser for both components and combine them correctly. The second axis must retain imaginary information. <wiki-ref to="complex-transform"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 中间数据可能已有实部和虚部。分别用自己的频谱仪处理两张实数表，再按 i²=−1 合并，保留完整复数输出。
brief.en: Intermediate data may already have real and imaginary parts. Analyse each real-valued table with your analyser, then combine using i²=−1, retaining a complex output.

naiveWhy.zh: 第二条输入也是信号。二维的第二轴不能丢弃第一轴产生的虚部。
naiveWhy.en: The imaginary input also carries signal. A second-axis transform must retain first-axis imaginary data.

hint.zh: 将 (a+ib)(c+id) 的四项贡献分为实部和虚部，i²=−1；算术由元件执行。
hint.en: Group the four contributions of (a+ib)(c+id), using i²=−1. Parts do the arithmetic.

desc.zh: 复用两次自己的逐行频谱仪，接收并输出实部、虚部。
desc.en: Reuse your row analyser on real/imaginary inputs and retain both outputs.
